repos.description: 网络质量检测脚本 - Network Quality Check Script
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本提供全面的网络质量检测，支持多平台与双栈，集成BGP查询、三网延迟路由、国内外测速等功能，可视化报告直观易读，适用于网络诊断与优化，支持JSON输出及弹性测试模式。
repos.summary_en: This script offers comprehensive network quality checking across multiple platforms and dual-stack support. It integrates BGP lookup, tri-network latency routing, domestic and international speed tests, with visually appealing reports. Ideal for network diagnostics and optimization, it supports JSON output and flexible testing modes.

repos.description: C-SSH 0.9.0 · Windows / Apple Silicon Mac / Android · SSH, RDP, AI & self-hosted cloud. Manual download required. 三端正式版，本次须手动下载安装。
repos.summary_zh: C-SSH是一款跨平台服务器运维客户端，集成SSH、RDP、AI对话及自托管云功能。支持Windows、Mac、Android及Linux多端手动下载，本地Agent无需云端登录，数据保留本地，提升运维效率与安全性。
repos.summary_en: C-SSH is a powerful cross-platform server operations client integrating SSH, RDP, AI, and self-hosted cloud capabilities. It supports manual downloads across Windows, macOS, Android, and Linux, featuring local Agent support without requiring cloud login, keeping AI conversations and credentials local for secure, efficient, and flexible server management.

repos.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。
repos.summary_zh: CoShell是一款本地优先、安全加密的轻量级桌面SSH/SFTP工作台，深度集成AI智能体。它融合了多标签终端、文件管理与在线编辑，为本地可信环境提供安全离线的AI辅助运维与开发体验。
repos.summary_en: CoShell is a local-first, lightweight desktop SSH and SFTP workstation designed for secure, offline server operations. Integrating a powerful AI agent compatible with OpenAI APIs, local SearXNG search, and an online code editor, it combines multi-tab terminals, SFTP file management, and advanced AES-GCM encryption. It offers a privacy-focused, all-in-one environment for developers and system administrators to execute commands, edit files, and automate workflows safely within trusted local environments, without requiring external dependencies like Docker or CDNs, helping to streamline daily server maintenance and development tasks efficiently.
